contracts: (Snapshot verification reports every required result-determining category bound immutably before replay; omission or mutability makes reconstruction ineligible.) AND (The S6 test verifies unchanged paths and rejects an injected path mutation.) AND (The comparison finds no added, removed, or altered historical tracked member; any difference rejects the repair.) AND (The preservation check establishes unchanged protected bytes; any protected-byte difference is rejected.)

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.
selector_intents: Exercise snapshot verification with a required result-determining input omitted or mutable and observe closed invalidation.
Exercise the historical-byte comparison with a changed protected byte and require the preservation check to reject it.
Introduce a membership difference in the comparison input and require the historical-integrity check to fail.
Introduce a rename, relocation, or rewrite into the S6 path-baseline comparison fixture.
